name: Freeze-Dry
description: You unleash a freezing cold air that rapidly chills a creature in range. Make a ranged attack on a creature, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. On a natural attack roll of 19 or 20, the target is frozen. This move deals super effective damage to water-type creatures. If the target’s secondary type is resistant to {type} damage, this move deals standard damage instead.
